skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of finance, money, financial system, national budget, interest rates, corporate finance, credit, financial markets, commercial banks, central bank policies, inflation.

Recognize the differences between financial and monetary issues, relationships within the financial system, contents of the national budget, measurement of interest rates, models affecting interest rates, basics of corporate finance, forms of credit in the economy, structure and financial instruments, activities of commercial banks and central banks, causes, effects, and measures against inflation.
Recognize basic factors influencing the operations of finance and money.
Apply knowledge to analyze and solve problems arising in specific practical situations related to monetary and financial theories.
Develop independent work skills, dynamic and diverse teamwork skills, presentation skills.
